import os, socket, subprocess, urllib.request

print("=== 1. Script / contract presence ===")
for p in ('/tmp/start_replicated_kv.sh', '/tmp/replicated_kv_contract.md'):
    print(f"  {p}: exists={os.path.exists(p)}")

print("\n=== 2. Any new files in /tmp since last check ===")
print("  ", sorted(os.listdir('/tmp')))

print("\n=== 3. Client tools / service binaries on PATH ===")
for name in ('kv', 'kvctl', 'kv-client', 'kvcli', 'replicated_kv', 'raftkv', 'storectl', 'etcdctl'):
    found = subprocess.run(f"command -v {name}", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    print(f"  {name}: {found or '(not found)'}")

print("\n=== 4. Port scan 2000-9999 (open TCP) ===")
open_ports = []
for port in range(2000, 10000):
    s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(0.02)
    if s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1', port)) == 0:
        open_ports.append(port)
    s.close()
print("  open:", open_ports if open_ports else "(none)")
